info.title: pdf-lib-workers
info.description:
Edit, merge, split, fill, stamp and inspect PDFs. Results are stored in R2 and returned as signed links.

**Workflow that works well:**
1. **Inspect first.** `POST /pdf/info` returns pages, sizes, form fields (names, types, choices), layers and attachments.
2. **Act.** `/pdf/edit`, `/pdf/merge` and `/pdf/create` all take an `operations` list, run in order, so one request can build, stamp and lock a document.
3. **Verify.** Run `/pdf/info` or `/pdf/text` on the result's `key`.

**Sending files.** Any field typed Source, PdfSource or MergeSource accepts a URL string, an R2 key string, or an object: `{ "url" }` (optionally with `headers`), `{ "key" }`, `{ "base64" }`, or `{ "upload" }` naming a multipart file. Send files as multipart/form-data with the JSON body in an `options` field, or POST a PDF as the raw body with the JSON body URL-encoded in `?options=`.

**Getting results.** By default a PDF result is saved to R2 and returned as a PdfResult with a signed `url` that works without the API key until `expiresAt`. Send `Accept: application/pdf` to get the bytes instead (with `X-File-Key`, `X-File-Url` and `X-Page-Count` headers); without it, or with `*/*`, the response is JSON. The API's own result links can be passed back in as sources.

**Things that trip people up:**
- Coordinates are PDF points (72 per inch) from the **bottom-left** corner. Add `"origin": "top-left"` to measure y down from the top.
- Pages are **1-based**; negative numbers count from the end.
- Built-in fonts cover Latin text only. Pass a font file for other scripts; text a font cannot draw is rejected (400), never replaced with "?".
- Some sites block requests from Cloudflare Workers (403 from the source URL). Send those files as uploads or base64.
- Opening a PDF with `password` saves the result **without** a password; add an `encrypt` operation to lock it again.
- Run `setMetadata` before `convertToPDFA`.
- Errors are JSON (ErrorResponse) and name the failing input, e.g. `operations[2] (removePages): Page 9 is out of range`.

post.summary: Pages, boxes, metadata, form fields, layers, viewer preferences, attachments
post.description: Reads everything about a PDF except its content: pages and their boxes, metadata (including copyright and custom fields), form fields with their types, choices and settings, layers, viewer preferences and attachments. Call it before editing to learn field names and page sizes. An encrypted PDF sent without its password returns a LockedInfoResponse, not an error.

options.description: The InfoRequest as JSON. Files in this request are used with { "upload": "<field or file name>" }.

additionalProperties.description: A file. Field names may repeat; repeated ones are addressed as name[0], name[1], …

schema.description: The PDF itself, used as the source. Put the rest of the request in ?options=.

200.description: An InfoResponse, or a LockedInfoResponse for an encrypted PDF sent without its password.

400.description: Invalid request: bad JSON or fields (see details), a page out of range, an unknown form field, a font missing characters.

404.description: No file at an R2 key used as a source.

500.description: API_KEY is not set, or an unexpected error.

502.description: A URL source returned an error or could not be reached.

post.summary: Join PDFs and images, then run operations
post.description: Joins PDFs (whole or chosen pages) and PNG/JPEG images in order, each image becoming one page, then runs an optional operations list on the result. In a multipart request "sources" may be left out: every uploaded PDF and image is merged in the order sent, except files the operations use, such as a watermark logo.

text.description: Text to stamp. Give text or image.

image.description: A PNG or JPEG to stamp, e.g. a logo. Give text or image.

scale.description: Images: width as a share of the page width.

rotate.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise. Default: 45 for text, 0 for images.

margin.description: Distance from the page edge, for corner positions.

WatermarkOperation.description: Stamps text or an image (give one) on each page, centred or in a corner, at any angle and opacity.

pages.description: Pages to apply this to. Default: every page.

format.description: Text to write; "{page}" and "{total}" are replaced.

fields.description: Text fields take a string; checkboxes true/false; dropdowns and option lists an option or array of options; radio groups an option.

images.description: Images for text fields or buttons, by field name (e.g. a signature box).

flatten.description: Turn the fields into plain page content afterwards, so they can no longer be edited.

strict.description: Fail on unknown field names instead of ignoring them.

font.description: Font for the filled-in values. Default: Helvetica. Use a font file for non-Latin text.

FillFormOperation.description: Fills form fields by name (see /pdf/info for names and types).

font.description: Font used to draw the values. Default: Helvetica.

FlattenFormOperation.description: Turns all form fields into plain page content.

RadioChoice.description: One radio button: its value and its box.

y.description: Bottom edge (bottom-left origin) or top edge (top-left origin).

value.description: Starting value: text, checkbox true/false, the selected option(s).

choices.description: Radio groups: one entry per choice, each with its own box.

exported.description: false keeps the field's value out of form submissions.

maxLength.description: Text fields: maximum characters; null removes the limit.

fontSize.description: Text fields, dropdowns, option lists and buttons. 0 = auto-size.

password.description: Text fields: hide the characters typed.

comb.description: Text fields: one character per box across the field's width (needs maxLength).

scroll.description: Text fields: allow text longer than the box.

fileSelect.description: Text fields: the value is a file path.

options.description: Dropdowns and option lists: the choices.

editable.description: Dropdowns: allow typing a value not in the list.

selectOnClick.description: Dropdowns and option lists: commit the choice as soon as it is clicked.

offToggle.description: Radio groups: clicking the selected option clears it.

mutuallyExclusive.description: Radio groups, addFormField only: true (default) turns on one button at a time; false turns on every button sharing the chosen value.

AddFormFieldOperation.description: Creates a form field. Text, checkbox, dropdown, optionList and button need page, x, y, width and height; radio needs choices.

exported.description: false keeps the field's value out of form submissions.

maxLength.description: Text fields: maximum characters; null removes the limit.

fontSize.description: Text fields, dropdowns, option lists and buttons. 0 = auto-size.

password.description: Text fields: hide the characters typed.

comb.description: Text fields: one character per box across the field's width (needs maxLength).

scroll.description: Text fields: allow text longer than the box.

fileSelect.description: Text fields: the value is a file path.

options.description: Dropdowns and option lists: the choices.

editable.description: Dropdowns: allow typing a value not in the list.

selectOnClick.description: Dropdowns and option lists: commit the choice as soon as it is clicked.

offToggle.description: Radio groups: clicking the selected option clears it.

mutuallyExclusive.description: Radio groups, addFormField only: true (default) turns on one button at a time; false turns on every button sharing the chosen value.

image.description: Text fields and buttons: an image to show in the field.

font.description: Font used to redraw the field. Default: Helvetica.

SetFieldPropertiesOperation.description: Changes a field's settings, or shows an image in it.

SetFieldScriptOperation.description: Replaces the script of a field's existing action (see /pdf/scripts). New actions cannot be added.

AddJavaScriptOperation.description: Adds document-level JavaScript, run when the PDF opens in viewers that allow it.

SetXFAJavaScriptOperation.description: Replaces a script in an XFA form. The source needs "preserveXFA": true.

DeleteXFAOperation.description: Removes XFA form data, leaving the regular form fields.

SetLayerVisibilityOperation.description: Shows or hides layers (optional content groups). See /pdf/info for layer names.

displayDocTitle.description: Show the title, not the file name, in the window bar.

pageMode.description: Which panel is open, or full screen.

nonFullScreenPageMode.description: Panel shown after leaving full screen.

printScaling.description: Print dialog default; "None" prints at actual size.

numCopies.description: Print dialog's default number of copies.

SetViewerPreferencesOperation.description: Controls how viewers open the PDF.

showTitleInWindow.description: Show the title instead of the file name in viewers' title bar.

creator.description: The application that made the original content.

producer.description: The application that made the PDF.

copyright.description: e.g. "© 2026 Acme Inc. All rights reserved." Shown as Acrobat's copyright notice.

copyrightUrl.description: Page with licence or ownership details.

custom.description: Your own fields, e.g. { "MadeFor": "Client X" }. Keys start with a letter, then letters, digits or _ (max 64). null removes a field.

SetMetadataOperation.description: Sets document properties, copyright and custom fields, in both the Info dictionary and XMP. Run it before convertToPDFA.

relationship.description: How the file relates to the PDF (PDF/A-3 associated files).

AttachFileOperation.description: Embeds a file inside the PDF.

colorComponents.description: Components of the ICC profile: 1 gray, 3 RGB, 4 CMYK.

ConvertToPDFAOperation.description: Adds what PDF/A requires (sRGB output intent, file ID, XMP). Text must use an embedded font file, and the PDF must not be encrypted.

EmbedFacturXOperation.description: Makes a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoice: attaches your invoice XML and makes the PDF PDF/A-3. The XML is not generated or checked.

Permissions.description: What user-password holders may do. Everything is allowed unless set to false.

userPassword.description: Needed to open the file. Empty or omitted: opens without a password, permissions still apply.

allowWeakCryptography.description: Required for RC4, which is broken; only for viewers older than 2005.

EncryptOperation.description: Password-protects the PDF. Applied when the file is saved.

Operation.description: One step of an `operations` list. Steps run in order.

InfoRequest.description: A locked PDF sent without its password returns a LockedInfoResponse.

items.description: Also return each text run with its position, size and font.

include.description: What to extract. Each choice adds that field to the response ("attachments" at the top level, the rest per page).

store.description: Save images and attachments to R2 and return signed links; false returns them as base64.

prefix.description: R2 key prefix for stored files. Default: "extracted/<uuid>/", which the recommended expiry rule deletes after 7 days.

linkTtl.description: Lifetime of the signed download link, in seconds (max 604800 = 7 days). Default: the SIGNED_URL_TTL setting (3600).

text.description: Text to measure. "\n" always starts a new line.

maxWidth.description: Wrap at this width, in points, and return the lines.

wordBreaks.description: Characters after which a line may wrap.

fitHeight.description: Also return the font size whose text height equals this.

MeasureRequest.description: Measures text before you lay it out. No PDF needed.

pageCount.description: Blank pages to start with. With 0, add pages with addPage.

operations.description: Steps to run, in order (max 500). A failing step is named in the error: operations[2] (removePages): …
Steps to run, in order (max 500). A failing step is named in the error: operations[2] (removePages): …

incremental.description: Keep the original bytes and append the changes, so existing digital signatures stay valid.

sources.description: PDFs and images, in order. In a multipart request it may be left out: every uploaded PDF and image is merged in the order sent, except files the operations use.

operations.description: Steps to run on the merged document.

every.description: Pages per part, when ranges is not given.

prefix.description: R2 key prefix for the parts. Default: "outputs/<uuid>/".

linkTtl.description: Lifetime of the signed download link, in seconds (max 604800 = 7 days). Default: the SIGNED_URL_TTL setting (3600).

SplitRequest.description: Splits a PDF into parts saved in R2.

Box.description: A page box in points: lower-left corner (x, y), width and height.

key.description: R2 key of the saved file.

url.description: Signed download link; works without the API key until expiresAt.

StoredPdf.description: The PDF was saved to R2.

InlinePdf.description: The PDF itself, for output.store: false.

PdfResult.description: Result of create, edit or merge as JSON (the default; see the Accept header).

PageBoxes.description: Media = paper size; crop = visible area; bleed, trim and art are for print production.

FieldSettings.description: A field's settings; which ones appear depends on the field type.

value.description: text: string or null; checkbox: boolean; dropdown/optionList: selected options; radio: selected option or null; others: null.

options.description: Choices, for dropdowns, option lists and radio groups.

ViewerPreferences.description: pageMode and pageLayout are always present; the rest only when the PDF sets viewer preferences.

custom.description: Custom fields set with setMetadata (or by other tools).

pdfA.description: PDF/A part and level, e.g. "3B", or null.

hasJavaScript.description: Whether the PDF has document-level JavaScript; see /pdf/scripts.

LockedInfoResponse.description: An encrypted PDF sent without its password: only its structure is readable.

text.description: Text in drawing order, with a new line where the baseline moves. Scanned pages have none (no OCR).

drawWidth.description: Size drawn on the page, in points.

key.description: R2 key of the saved file.

url.description: Signed download link; works without the API key until expiresAt.

drawWidth.description: Size drawn on the page, in points.

key.description: R2 key of the saved file.

url.description: Signed download link; works without the API key until expiresAt.

width.description: Width of the widest line, in points.

height.description: Height of one line of text, including descenders.

blockHeight.description: Height of all lines, using lineHeight between baselines.

sizeForHeight.description: With fitHeight: the font size whose text height equals it.

key.description: R2 key of the saved file.

url.description: Signed download link; works without the API key until expiresAt.

pages.description: 1-based source pages in this part.

error.description: What went wrong. Names the failing input, e.g. sources[1] or operations[2] (removePages).

details.description: For 400 validation errors: each invalid field.
